scientific_integrity: The new assertion is a matching lower bound derived from cited literature, not a claim to reprove the source estimates. Independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Assumes GRH for Dirichlet L-functions; no exact asymptotic sign proportion and no optimality assertion for the one-half coefficient. The proof uses Thakur’s published character-tail lemma and upper sign-count estimate.
title: Positive prime classes and the correct order of the exceptional signs in a Möbius constant
